content: Tetela ꞌana ꞌebe eꞌale
Ye ꞌinapwana Tiopilo. Niꞌatu tomota yaudi Yesu tetelina siꞌetoladina toꞌase nadigega ꞌina guinuwa ꞌedaya manuna.
Tetela nidi siꞌetoladidi toꞌase nadigega taudi toꞌawaꞌaiꞌailao sigimiꞌitena, ꞌenega siloguguya ga siemwasala ꞌemaya,
ta esi yage nidi maiboꞌadi gimitutega ga batuwa yamwalatoi ꞌaiꞌailidi, ꞌenega nuwanuwagu be ꞌaene yage nidi maiboꞌadi yada emwasala ꞌaiꞌailidi ꞌemuya,
be ꞌenega yage nidi niꞌatu ꞌunonodi ꞌaledi ꞌuda mwalatonidi be wate ꞌuda ꞌawa ꞌaiꞌailedi.
Ilisabeti ꞌina ꞌeuwana

ꞌIgu emwasala ꞌana ꞌebe eꞌale gete nadigega: Tuta nina Yudia ꞌena Elodi ꞌietoloina, totaliya ꞌebweu ꞌana esana Sakalaya ꞌimiyami. Tauna totaliya nina Ebaya ꞌina boda ꞌediyega. Ta mwanena ꞌana esana Ilisabeti, tauna wate totaliyao ꞌidi boda ꞌebweu.
Ta siteluwa nidi Yaubada matanaya sibubuna palupaluna, manuna Yaubada ꞌina loina maiboꞌana siematamatana ꞌaiꞌailena.
Ta nigeya natudimo, manuna Ilisabeti megamegagalina ga wate niꞌatu ꞌikaiyale, ta wate mwanena niꞌatu ꞌieꞌinapwana.
ꞌEnega ꞌebweu tuta ꞌenaya Sakalaya ma ina bodao taliya siguiguinuwa, ta ꞌasiyata nina ꞌena Sakalaya nina ꞌina tuta be taliya ꞌida guinuwe Yaubada matanaya.
Manuna nadigega ꞌidi bubuna, ga gosenao ꞌediyega esinuwa ꞌilobena, ꞌenega ꞌInapwana ꞌina Anuwa Tabu ꞌena ꞌilugu be ꞌaene galaꞌu
ꞌida gabu ꞌebe taliya ꞌenaya.
Tuta nina galaꞌu ꞌana gabu ꞌana tuta ta boda sinabwana anuwa ꞌatamaninaya Yaubada ꞌena sisidasida.
ꞌEnega Yaubada ꞌina anilose ꞌiapwesa Sakalaya matanaya, ga galaꞌu ꞌana ꞌebe gabu ꞌatainega ꞌitoolo.
Gote ꞌena Sakalaya ꞌiꞌitena ga nuwana ꞌiowana, ta wate ma ina matauta.
Ta anilose ꞌigwae, “Sakalaya, geyaꞌabo ꞌumatamatauta. Yaubada ꞌimu sida niꞌatu ꞌinonona, ꞌenega mwaneyo Ilisabeti natuyo meꞌolotona ꞌienatunei be ꞌueese Yoni.
ꞌEnega ꞌuda gwausowala ta wate tomota maiboꞌadi sida gwausowala gwama nina ꞌina tubuwa manuna.
Manuna natumuna ꞌiabe ꞌana esana sinabwana Yaubada matanaya, ta geyaꞌabo oine nai bwasi waiwaidi ꞌinumanumadi, ta ꞌiabe ꞌina tubuwaꞌunu ꞌenega ꞌida maa Yaluyaluwa Tabunega.
Be ꞌenega tauna me Isileli yaudi ꞌida ꞌauꞌewa limedima ꞌidi ꞌInapwana Yaubada ꞌenaya.

Ta tauna ꞌiabe ma ina waiwai ta ma ina ꞌatepatu, be Yaubada manuna ꞌida etosimana, ta ꞌina waiwai nadigega lowa palopita Ilaitiya ꞌina waiwai. Be ꞌenega guguya ꞌenega tama ꞌida giesana iledi be natudiyao sida nuwaꞌiꞌisi limedi. Be wate taudi toleꞌoa loina ꞌida giesana iledima ꞌeda palupaluna ꞌenaya, be ꞌenega ꞌInapwana ꞌina tomotaiyao ꞌida gibubudi ꞌina mai manuna.”
Ga Sakalaya anilose nina ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Ona gete ꞌana nono ꞌeguya kwanikwanina, manuna ꞌaboꞌagu niꞌatu yaetai sinabwa, ta mwanegu wate ꞌikaiyale.”
Ta anilose nina ꞌigwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu Gebeliela, ta tuta yauna Yaubada matanaya yatootoolo, ta gete tuga Tauna ꞌietuneguma be ale gete boboꞌana yasimane ꞌemuya.

Ta ꞌoyo esi ꞌigu ale nina ꞌemuya nigeya ꞌuemiemise, ꞌenega ꞌiabe meyayo ꞌimwamwau be nigeya kapekapeyana ꞌuoona be ꞌana laba ꞌigu ale nina ꞌana mwalatoi ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌiapwesa be ꞌenega ona ꞌuꞌinana lima.”
Ta tomota maiboꞌadi ꞌetamo tuga ꞌatamanaya siyamwayamwa, ta sinuwanuwa toꞌase ꞌalena Sakalaya ꞌisoꞌisoꞌi Anuwa Tabu solanaya.

ꞌEnega Sakalaya ꞌiapwesa, ta nigeya kapekapeyana be ꞌiona ꞌediya, manuna meyana ꞌimwau. Gete ꞌenega simwalatonina ꞌaene niꞌatu Anuwa Tabu solanaya weꞌiweꞌiyaya ꞌiꞌitena. Ta nigeya sawesawenaya be ꞌiona ꞌediya, ta tuga nimanega ꞌienimasusumo.
Ta Sakalaya ꞌina taliya ꞌana ꞌasiyatao sigumwalaya ga ꞌiila limana ꞌina ꞌasaya.
Ta tuta gete mulinaya, mwanena Ilisabeti ꞌiꞌeuwana, ga nawalae nima soladiya nigeya ꞌida adadana ta esiya anuwaya ꞌimiyamiya
ta ꞌigwae, “Gete ꞌagu lema Yaubada ꞌenega. Lowa megagaligu ꞌenega yaomayamaya, ga gete tuga omayamaya ꞌigumwala.”
Meli ꞌina enatuna ꞌalena tetelina
Ta niꞌatu Ilisabeti ꞌina nawalae sikisi sigumwala, ga Yaubada ꞌina anilose Gebeliela ꞌietunena ga ꞌimai sena Galili ꞌena, ꞌebweu ꞌasa ꞌana esana Nasaleta ꞌenaya,
ga ꞌebweu gomagweine nuwenuwebolana ꞌena ꞌiapwesa, ꞌana esana Meli. Gomagweine nina tauna Yosepa ꞌena sisawa eyaiyena, ta tai nina Debida ꞌina susuyega.
Ta anilose nina ꞌimai ga ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Kagutoki Meli. ꞌInapwana ꞌina oboboma sinabwana ꞌemuya, ta tauna maꞌiyayo.”
ꞌEnega Meli nuwana ꞌiowana ga ꞌinuwanuwa edaedadama, ona nina ꞌana mwalatoi manuna.
Ta anilose nina ꞌigwae, “Meli, geyaꞌabo ꞌumatamatauta, ta Yaubada ꞌina oboboma sinabwa wawasae ꞌemuya ꞌimiyami,
be ꞌenega ꞌiabe ꞌuꞌeuwana be natuyo meꞌolotona ꞌuenatune, be ꞌana esana ꞌuda eese Yesu.
Tauna maꞌetamo ꞌietoewaiwai be tomota sida bwauye tauna Toloetana sana Natuna, be ꞌInapwana Yaubada loina waiwaina ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌe, nadigega tubuna Debida ꞌina loina,
be ꞌenega Yekobe ꞌina bodao ꞌiloinedi, ta ꞌina loina nina geyaꞌabo ꞌigumwagumwala.”
Ta Meli ꞌiona anilose nina ꞌenaya, ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega batu saꞌi gete? Manuna ꞌaboꞌagu nigeya yaaiai!”
Ta anilose nina ꞌigwae, “Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌiabe ꞌemuya ꞌimwaꞌutama be Yaubada ꞌida giewaiwaiyeyo be natuyo ꞌuenatune gwama ꞌesasena, tauna ꞌiabe sieese Yaubada Natuna.
Ta ꞌuda mwalatoni ꞌaene nibayo Ilisabeti ꞌikaiyale ta megagalina, ta esi ꞌiꞌeuwana, ga niꞌatu ꞌina nawalae sikisi.
Manuna yage maiboꞌana Yaubada sawesawenaya.”
ꞌEnega Meli ꞌigwae, “ꞌAgoꞌagu Yaubada ꞌina toguinuwa. Toꞌase ꞌimu ona ꞌeguya nadigega ꞌida apwesa tuga.” ꞌEnega anilose nina Meli ꞌiebesinena ga ꞌitauya.
Meli ꞌina ayausa Ilisabeti ꞌenaya
Ta tuta gete mulinaya Meli ꞌitoolo ga Yudia ꞌoyanao ꞌituꞌetaodi ga ꞌebweu ꞌasa ꞌena ꞌiapwesa.
ꞌEnega Sakalaya ꞌina anuwaya ꞌilugu ga nibana Ilisabeti ꞌilokagutokiyena.
Ta tuta nina Ilisabeti lokagutoki nina nibana ꞌenega ꞌinonona ga gwama nina gamwanaya ꞌiloniu, ta Yaluyaluwa Tabuna Ilisabeti nina ꞌiloemaena,
ta ꞌenana sinabwanega ꞌibwau, ꞌigwae, “ꞌEniba, Yaubada ꞌiobobomemuya, nigeya ꞌebweu wate yaita waine nadigega ꞌoyo. Ta natumuna ꞌiabe ꞌuenatune gomagomabwainina.
Ta mwaꞌadega ga ꞌenega ꞌoyo ꞌigu ꞌInapwana sinana, ta ꞌumai ga ꞌuayausigu?
Ta ꞌuꞌita, ꞌimu lokagutoki yanonona, ga gwama ꞌina gwausowala ꞌenega gamwaguya ꞌiloniu sinabwana.
Ta ꞌoyo ꞌInapwana ꞌina ale ꞌana toemisa, ꞌenega ma imu gwausowala, manuna ꞌiabe ꞌana ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌiapwesa ꞌemuya.”
Ta Meli ꞌigwae, “Tuta yauna ꞌateguyega ꞌInapwana yatuputupu,
ta yagwaugwausowala Yaubada tauna ꞌagu Toꞌetoseyana ꞌenaya.
Manuna ꞌaboꞌagu tuga ꞌina toguinuwa gomagomabesogu, ta tuwa tuga ꞌiꞌita mwaꞌutama be ꞌenega tuta simeemai ꞌediya ꞌepata auwaudi maiboꞌadi situpugu.
Manuna Yaubada tauna Toewaiwai sana guinuwa waiwaina ꞌiguinuwena manugu, ta tauna ꞌana esana ꞌesasena ta etaetabuna.
Tauna ꞌana toꞌamayabao ꞌepata ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌediyega ꞌiꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyedi.
Ta esi taudi togagasao be tonuwatuꞌeyao nimana waiwaina ꞌenega ꞌiꞌausepaledi.
Toesaesa nidi ꞌigimwaꞌutedi ꞌidi ꞌebemi esaesa ꞌediyega ta togomabeso ꞌigilagasidi.
Ta wate tobotana ꞌieꞌenidi ga gamwadi ꞌipawa, ta toesaesao maanimenimedimo ꞌietune iledi.
Ta tauna ꞌina onaupaupa nina tubudao ꞌediya ꞌinuwaꞌiꞌisina ꞌenega ꞌaboꞌada me Isileli ꞌiꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyeda ga ꞌiꞌetoseyeda.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, tubudao nidi taudi Ebelaamo ma ina susuyao ꞌediya ꞌionaupaupa be ꞌaene ꞌida ꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌole ataedi.”
Ta Meli ꞌina onao niꞌatu ꞌilosalonidi, ꞌenega manibana simiyana nawalae ꞌetoi, ga muliyega ꞌiila limana ꞌina ꞌasaya.
Yoni togiebapitaiso ꞌina tubuwa
Ta tuta nina Ilisabeti ꞌienatunaya ga gwama nina meꞌolotona.
ꞌEnega ꞌina bodao ta wate gosenao Yaubada ꞌina oboboma ꞌenaya sinonona ga maiboꞌadi maꞌenao siegwausowala leleleya.
Ta gwama nina ꞌina tuta tubuwa mulinaya ga niꞌatu ꞌasiyata sebeni, ꞌenega ꞌina bodao sideli egogonama gwama nina bwalana sabi dabana
be ꞌenega ꞌaene tamana ꞌena siewaliyesae.
Ga sinana ꞌiꞌetoboda, ꞌigwae, “Nigeya! Ta esi ꞌana esana Yoni.”
ꞌEnega sigwae, “Nate esana nina nigeya ꞌomi ꞌami esana!”
ꞌEnega enimasusuyega tamana sienaidena be ꞌaene mwaꞌadega gwama ꞌana esana sida eese.
Ga Sakalaya ꞌebe ꞌetoladi ꞌisidena ga gwama nina ꞌana esana ꞌiꞌetoladinaya, ꞌigwae, “ꞌAna esana Yoni.” ꞌEnega boda maiboꞌadi siꞌitena ga nuwadi ꞌiowana.
Ta tuta gote ꞌenaya Sakalaya meyana ꞌikapekapeyana limana, ga ꞌiona, ga Yaubada ꞌitupuna.
Ga ꞌenega gosenao nidi maiboꞌadi simatauta, ta tetela nina ꞌisakowasi Yudia ꞌoyanao ta senanao maiboꞌadi ꞌediya.
Ta tomota nidi yaisigedi sinonona sinuwa edaedadamina, ꞌenega taudimo sienaidedi, sigwae, “Gwama gete mwaꞌadega ꞌiabe ꞌina guinuwa?” Manuna siꞌitena Yaubada ꞌina waiwai ꞌenaya ꞌimiyami.
Ta tamanana Sakalaya Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌiloemaena ga ꞌenega ꞌionaupaupa, ꞌigwae,
“ꞌInapwana tada tupu, tauna me Isileli ꞌida Yaubada, manuna niꞌatu ꞌiayausida sabi lemeda be miyamwau ꞌenega ꞌiliꞌamida.
ꞌEnega tauna Yaubada ꞌina ꞌaliꞌei Debida ꞌina susuyega ꞌida Toꞌetoseyana nina ꞌigieapwesena ꞌedaya.
Lowaenei palopitao nuganuganidi Yaubada ꞌina ona gete nadigega sigimi simanena
ꞌaene ꞌida ꞌetoseyeda ꞌada talauwalao ꞌediyega, ta wate taudi ꞌada toeꞌidiꞌidiyao ꞌediyega,
ta wate lowa ꞌionaupaupa be ꞌaene gimi tubudao ꞌiꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyedi, ta ꞌina onaupaupa nina geyaꞌabo ꞌinuwanuwa pupulei.
Onaupaupa gete tubuda Ebelaamo manuna Yaubada ꞌenega
be ꞌaene ꞌida liꞌamida ꞌada saiyao ꞌediyega ta ma ida ꞌatepatu ꞌenaya tada guinuwa,
ta wate ꞌaene ma ida bubuna ꞌesasena ta palupaluna ꞌasiyata ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna.
Ta ꞌoyo natugu, sida eeseyo Toloetana sana ꞌina palopita, manuna ꞌoyo ꞌiabe ꞌununugana be ꞌida ꞌInapwana ꞌina ꞌeda ꞌugibubu,
ta wate ꞌina tomotaiyao ꞌuemataluwedi be ꞌaene ꞌidi bubuna toꞌumalina ꞌadi nuwatau ꞌediyega ꞌetoseyana siloba.
Manuna gete, Yaubada ꞌina yala be ꞌina ꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌole ꞌedaya be ꞌetoseyana ꞌina maedana ꞌida gimisae ꞌedaya,
be ꞌenega taudi wate guguyoi be mwawasa senanao ꞌediya simiyami ꞌida giemaedanedi, be ꞌenega maiboꞌada ꞌida anuganeda gwausowala ꞌana ꞌeda ꞌenaya.”
Ta niꞌatu gwama nina ꞌisinabwa ta yaluyaluwana wate ꞌiewaiwai. ꞌEnega tebweuna sena mwatui daitaya ꞌitauya ga nada ꞌiloꞌasa ga ꞌana laba me Isileli ꞌediya ꞌiapwesa ga ꞌiloguguya.

footnotes.text: galaꞌu: ꞌEbweu yage sigabuna Anuwa Tabu solanaya, maina boboꞌana, ta dimudimu sieesena inisenisi (incense).

daba nai lodaba: Nugana 17:10-14 ꞌena Yaubada Ebelaamo ꞌiloinena be ꞌaene tauna be natunao meꞌolotodi be tubunao meꞌolotodi ꞌidi yage bwaladi sida ꞌupwa yauledi, nate weꞌiweꞌiyaya nai ꞌebe ꞌinana sida guinuwe, ta ꞌana mwalatoi taudi Yaubada ꞌina tomotaiyao esiesinuwadi.
